name: Lissafin Yau da Kullum don Aiki da Rayuwa
objectives: Idan aka ba ku juzu'i, adadi mai ɗigo, kashi cikin ɗari da tef na awo, canja tsakanin juzu'i, adadi mai ɗigo da kashi cikin ɗari, da karanta tef na awo zuwa 1/8 na inci mafi kusa, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai
Idan aka ba ku farashi, lissafin kuɗi ko farashin albashi, lissafa rangwame, harajin saye, tip ko ƙarin albashi da kashi cikin ɗari, zuwa sisi (cent) mafi kusa
Idan aka ba ku girma biyu na kaya ɗaya da farashinsu, lissafa farashin kowane ma'auni na kowanne, da zaɓar saye mafi riba, kuna zaɓar daidai a aƙalla 4 cikin nau'i 5

Idan aka ba ku wani aiki kamar shimfiɗa ƙasan ɗaki ko rubuta sa'o'in aiki, canja ma'auni da lissafa faɗin wuri (area) ko sa'o'in aiki, da ma'aunin da ya dace, kuna tara sama idan kuna buƙatar cikakkun kaya
Idan aka ba ku takardar albashi, duba sa'o'i, farashin sa'a, overtime, ragi da albashin da ake karɓa a hannu layi-layi, kowane layi ya yi daidai har zuwa sisi, ko an rubuta kuskuren don a tambaya
Idan kuna da albashi na yau da kullum, yin kasafin kuɗi na wata mai ajiya, wanda kashe kuɗi bai wuce kuɗin shiga ba, da kowane rukuni a rubuce kuma an duba jimloli

chapters.name: Babi na 1: Lambobin da kuke amfani da su kowace rana

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Juzu'i, adadi mai ɗigo, kashi cikin ɗari da tef na awo
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Canja tsakanin juzu'i, adadi mai ɗigo da kashi cikin ɗari, da karanta tef na awo.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku juzu'i, adadi mai ɗigo, kashi cikin ɗari da tef na awo, za ku iya canja tsakanin juzu'i, adadi mai ɗigo da kashi cikin ɗari, da karanta tef na awo zuwa 1/8 na inci mafi kusa, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai.
Juzu'i, adadi mai ɗigo da kashi cikin ɗari hanyoyi uku ne na rubuta adadi ɗaya. Rabin fiza shi ne 1/2, ko 0.5, ko 50%. Kwata shi ne 1/4, 0.25 ko 25%. Kwata uku shi ne 3/4, 0.75 ko 75%.
Don canja juzu'i zuwa adadi mai ɗigo, ku raba lambar sama da lambar ƙasa: 3/8 shi ne 3 raba 8, wato 0.375. Don canja adadi mai ɗigo zuwa kashi cikin ɗari, ku matsar da ɗigon wurare biyu zuwa dama: 0.375 shi ne 37.5%. Don komawa daga kashi cikin ɗari zuwa adadi mai ɗigo, ku matsar da shi wurare biyu zuwa hagu: 15% shi ne 0.15.
Tef na awo a Amurka yana raba kowane inci zuwa ƙananan alamomi 16. Alama mafi tsawo a tsakiyar inci ita ce 1/2. Alamomi masu tsawo na gaba su ne 1/4 da 3/4. Sannan 1/8, 3/8, 5/8 da 7/8. Mafi gajeru su ne na 1/16. Idan tef ya tsaya alamomi 3 na 1/8 bayan 5, yana karanta inci 5 da 3/8.
Tara juzu'i masu lambar ƙasa ɗaya yana da sauƙi: ku tara lambobin sama, ku bar na ƙasa yadda yake. 1/8 + 3/8 = 4/8, wanda daidai yake da 1/2.
Mataki-mataki:
- Juzu'i zuwa adadi mai ɗigo: ku raba sama da ƙasa.
- Adadi mai ɗigo zuwa kashi cikin ɗari: ku matsar da ɗigon wurare 2 zuwa dama.
- Kashi cikin ɗari zuwa adadi mai ɗigo: ku matsar da ɗigon wurare 2 zuwa hagu.
- Tef na awo: ku nemo cikakken inci, sannan ku ƙirga alamomin da suka wuce shi.
- Sauƙaƙawa: 4/8 daidai yake da 1/2.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Juzu'i (fraction): ɓangare na cikakken abu, ana rubuta shi lamba a sama da lamba a ƙasa, kamar 3/4.
- Lambar sama (numerator): lambar saman juzu'i: ɓangarori nawa kuke da su.
- Lambar ƙasa (denominator): lambar ƙasan juzu'i: ɓangarori daidai nawa ne ke yin cikakken abu.
- Adadi mai ɗigo (decimal): lamba mai ɗigo, kamar 0.75, da ke nuna ɓangarorin cikakken abu.
- Kashi cikin ɗari (%): ɓangarori daga cikin 100. 25% yana nufin 25 cikin 100.
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye (amsoshi a ƙasa): (1) Ku rubuta 1/4 a matsayin adadi mai ɗigo da kashi cikin ɗari. (2) Ku rubuta 0.6 a matsayin kashi cikin ɗari. (3) Ku rubuta 8% a matsayin adadi mai ɗigo. (4) Ku canja 5/8 zuwa adadi mai ɗigo. (5) Ku tara 1/4 + 1/4. Amsoshi: (1) 0.25 da 25%; (2) 60%; (3) 0.08; (4) 0.625; (5) 2/4, wato 1/2. Idan kuna da tef na awo ko rula, ku auna abubuwa 3 a gida zuwa 1/8 na inci mafi kusa.
Yanzu za ku iya canja tsakanin juzu'i, adadi mai ɗigo da kashi cikin ɗari, da karanta tef na awo zuwa 1/8 na inci mafi kusa.

check.q: Nawa ne 3/4 a kashi cikin ɗari?
check.why: 3 raba 4 shi ne 0.75, kuma matsar da ɗigon wurare biyu zuwa dama yana ba da 75%.

check.q: Nawa ne 6% a adadi mai ɗigo?
check.why: Ku matsar da ɗigon wurare biyu zuwa hagu: 6% = 0.06.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Rangwame, harajin saye, tip da ƙarin albashi
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Lissafa rangwame, harajin saye, tip da ƙarin albashi da kashi cikin ɗari.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku farashi, lissafin kuɗi ko farashin albashi, za ku iya lissafa rangwame, harajin saye, tip ko ƙarin albashi da kashi cikin ɗari, zuwa sisi (cent) mafi kusa.
Don samun kashi cikin ɗari na wata lamba, ku canja kashi cikin ɗarin zuwa adadi mai ɗigo, sannan ku ninka. 20% na $45 shi ne 0.20 x 45 = $9.
Rangwame: ku cire shi daga farashin. Jaket na $45 da rangwamen 20% kuɗinsa 45 - 9 = $36. Harajin saye: ku ƙara shi. Idan harajin 8% ne, harajin $36 shi ne 0.08 x 36 = $2.88, don haka za ku biya $38.88. Yawan harajin saye ya bambanta a kowace jiha da birni; ku duba ofishin haraji na jiharku ko ku duba rasit.
Tip ba tare da na'urar lissafi ba: ku nemo 10% ta matsar da ɗigon wuri ɗaya zuwa hagu, sannan ku gina daga nan. A lissafin $28, 10% shi ne $2.80, 5% rabinsa ne, $1.40, don haka 15% shi ne $2.80 + $1.40 = $4.20. 20% ninki biyu ne na 10%: $5.60.
Ƙarin albashi: ƙarin 3% a kan $16.00 a sa'a shi ne 0.03 x 16 = $0.48, don haka sabon farashin shi ne $16.48 a sa'a. Ku kula da kalmomi: "rangwamen 20%" yana nufin kuna biyan 80% na farashin; "ƙarin 20%" yana nufin kuna biyan 120%.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku canja kashi cikin ɗarin zuwa adadi mai ɗigo.
- Ku ninka shi da adadin.
- Rangwame: ku cire. Haraji ko tip: ku ƙara. Ƙarin albashi: ku ƙara a kan tsohon farashin.
- Ku tara kuɗi zuwa sisi (cent) mafi kusa.
- Ku duba: amsar tana da ma'ana? Dole rangwame ya gaza farashin.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Rangwame (discount): kuɗin da aka cire daga farashi.
- Harajin saye (sales tax): harajin da ake ƙarawa a kan farashi lokacin biya; yawansa ya dogara da jiharku da birninku.
- Tip: ƙarin kuɗin da kuke bayarwa don hidima, sau da yawa ana lissafa shi a matsayin kashi cikin ɗari na lissafin.
- Ƙarin albashi (raise): ƙaruwar farashin albashinku.
- Tarawa (round): sauƙaƙa lamba; ana tara kuɗi zuwa sisi mafi kusa.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Federation of Tax Administrators: hanyoyin haɗi zuwa ofisoshin haraji na jihohi
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye (amsoshi a ƙasa): (1) Takalman aiki na $60 suna da rangwamen 25%. Mene ne farashin rangwamen? (2) Haraji 7% ne a kan kaya na $50. Nawa ne jimilla? (3) Ku nemo tip na 20% a kan lissafin $35. (4) Albashinku na $15.50 ya sami ƙarin 4%. Mene ne sabon farashin? Amsoshi: (1) $45; (2) harajin $3.50, jimilla $53.50; (3) $7.00; (4) ƙarin $0.62, $16.12 a sa'a. Sannan ku duba rasit na gaske ku nemo yawan harajin da aka caje a yankinku.
Yanzu za ku iya lissafa rangwame, harajin saye, tip da ƙarin albashi zuwa sisi mafi kusa.

check.q: Kot na $80 yana da rangwamen 25%. Mene ne farashin rangwamen?
Nawa ne tip na 15% a kan lissafin $40?
check.why: 10% shi ne $4.00, 5% kuma $2.00, don haka 15% shi ne $6.00.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Farashin kowane ma'auni: gano saye mafi riba
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Lissafa farashin kowane ma'auni da zaɓar saye mafi riba.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku girma biyu na kaya ɗaya da farashinsu, za ku iya lissafa farashin kowane ma'auni na kowanne, da zaɓar saye mafi riba, kuna zaɓar daidai a aƙalla 4 cikin nau'i 5.
Farashin kowane ma'auni (unit price) shi ne kuɗin ma'auni ɗaya: oza ɗaya, fam ɗaya, ko abu ɗaya. Yana ba ku damar kwatanta girma daban-daban cikin adalci. Don samunsa, ku raba farashin da yawan ma'aunin.
Misali: akwatin hatsin karin kumallo (cereal) na oza 24 kuɗinsa $4.80. $4.80 / 24 = $0.20 a kowace oza. Akwati na oza 36 kuɗinsa $6.12. $6.12 / 36 = $0.17 a kowace oza. Babban akwatin shi ne saye mafi riba.
Babba ba koyaushe ya fi arha ba. Buhun shinkafa na fam 2 a $3.18 shi ne $1.59 a kowane fam. Buhu na fam 5 a $8.45 shi ne $1.69 a kowane fam. A nan ƙaramin buhun shi ne saye mafi riba. Shaguna da yawa suna buga farashin kowane ma'auni da ƙananan haruffa a alamar farashin kan shiryayye; ku duba cewa alamomin biyu suna amfani da ma'auni ɗaya.
Saye mafi riba yana da riba ne kawai idan za ku yi amfani da shi kafin ya lalace kuma kuna iya biyan sa a wannan makon. Farashin kowane ma'auni yana taimakawa a wurin aiki ma, misali lokacin odar kayan aiki.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku rubuta farashi da girman kowane kaya.
- Ku tabbata ma'aunai sun yi daidai (oza da oza).
- Ku raba: farashi / girma = farashin kowane ma'auni.
- Ku kwatanta: mafi ƙarancin farashin kowane ma'auni shi ne saye mafi riba.
- Ku tambayi: zan yi amfani da shi duka, kuma ina iya biyan sa yanzu?
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Farashin kowane ma'auni (unit price): kuɗin ma'auni ɗaya, kamar oza ɗaya ko fam ɗaya.
- Oza (oz): ƙaramin ma'aunin nauyi; oza 16 suke yin fam 1.
- Fam (lb): ma'aunin nauyi da ya yi daidai da oza 16.
- Alamar farashi a shiryayye (shelf tag): alamar farashi a kan shiryayyen shago; sau da yawa tana nuna farashin kowane ma'auni.
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye (amsoshi a ƙasa): (1) Ƙwai 12 a $3.60 ko ƙwai 18 a $5.04? (2) Lemu oz 64 a $3.84 ko oz 128 a $6.40? Amsoshi: (1) $0.30 kowane ƙwai da $0.28 kowane ƙwai: ƙwai 18 ya fi; (2) $0.06 kowace oza da $0.05 kowace oza: oz 128 ya fi. Sannan, a shago ko a shafin intanet na shago, ku nemo farashin kowane ma'auni na abubuwa 3 da kuke yawan saye a girma biyu, ku rubuta saye mafi riba. Wannan zai shiga takardar aikinku na ƙarshe.
Yanzu za ku iya nemo farashin kowane ma'auni, zaɓar saye mafi riba, da sanin lokacin da babban girma bai cancanci saye ba.

check.q: Buhun dankali na fam 10 kuɗinsa $5.90. Mene ne farashin kowane ma'auni?
Sabulu A: guda 3 a $2.70. Sabulu B: guda 8 a $8.00. Wanne ne saye mafi riba?
options: Sabulu B, domin yana da guda da yawa
Kuɗinsu ɗaya ne a kowane guda
Sabulu B, domin ya fi tsada
Sabulu A, a $0.90 kowane guda da $1.00
check.why: $2.70 / 3 = $0.90 kuma $8.00 / 8 = $1.00, don haka A ya fi arha a kowane guda.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Lissafi don aiki da kuɗi

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Awo, canja ma'auni da ƙirga sa'o'in aiki
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Canja ma'auni da lissafa faɗin wuri (area) da sa'o'in aiki don wani aiki.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku wani aiki kamar shimfiɗa ƙasan ɗaki ko rubuta sa'o'in aiki, za ku iya canja ma'auni da lissafa faɗin wuri (area) ko sa'o'in aiki, da ma'aunin da ya dace, kuna tara sama idan kuna buƙatar cikakkun kaya.
Ma'aunan Amurka da aka saba: inci 12 = ƙafa 1, ƙafa 3 = yadi 1, oza 16 = fam 1, pint 2 = kwart 1, kwart 4 = galan 1. Wasu ayyuka suna amfani da ma'aunin metric: inci 1 = santimita 2.54, kuma kilo 1 kusan fam 2.2 ne. Don canja babban ma'auni zuwa ƙananan ma'aunai, ku ninka; don canja ƙananan ma'aunai zuwa babba, ku raba. Inci 90 / 12 = ƙafa 7.5.
Faɗin wuri (area) shi ne sararin da wuri mai faɗi ya rufe: tsawo x faɗi, a ma'aunin murabba'i. Ɗaki mai ƙafa 12 da ƙafa 10 shi ne 12 x 10 = ƙafa murabba'i 120. Idan akwati ɗaya na kayan shimfiɗa ƙasa ya rufe ƙafa murabba'i 20, kuna buƙatar akwatuna 120 / 20 = 6. Ma'aikata sukan ƙara kusan 10% don yanka da kuskure: 120 x 1.10 = 132, kuma 132 / 20 = 6.6. Ba za ku iya sayen 0.6 na akwati ba, don haka ku tara SAMA zuwa 7.
Sa'o'in aiki: ku ƙirga daga farawa zuwa ƙarewa, sannan ku cire hutun da ba a biya. Aiki daga 7:30 na safe zuwa 4:00 na yamma sa'o'i 8 1/2 ne; ku cire hutun abincin rana na minti 30 da ba a biya, ya zama sa'o'i 8. Katunan lokacin aiki da yawa suna amfani da sa'o'i a adadi mai ɗigo: minti 15 = 0.25, minti 30 = 0.5, minti 45 = 0.75. Wasu wuraren aiki suna amfani da agogon sa'o'i 24: 15:00 shi ne 3:00 na yamma.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku rubuta abin da kuke da shi da ma'aunin da kuke buƙata.
- Babban ma'auni zuwa ƙarami: ku ninka. Ƙarami zuwa babba: ku raba.
- Faɗin wuri: tsawo x faɗi, a ma'aunin murabba'i.
- Idan kuna buƙatar cikakkun kaya (akwatuna, buhuna): koyaushe ku tara sama.
- Sa'o'i: lokacin ƙarewa ban da lokacin farawa, ban da hutun da ba a biya; ku canja minti zuwa adadi mai ɗigo ta raba su da 60.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Ma'auni (unit): abin da kuke auna da shi, kamar inci, ƙafa, fam ko sa'a.
- Canja ma'auni (convert): mayar da awo daga wani ma'auni zuwa wani.
- Faɗin wuri (area): sararin da wuri mai faɗi ya rufe: tsawo sau faɗi, a ma'aunin murabba'i.
- Ƙafa murabba'i (sq ft): ma'aunin faɗin wuri idan kuna auna da ƙafa.
- Metric: tsarin awo da ake amfani da shi a yawancin duniya: santimita, mita, kilo, lita.
- Sa'o'i a adadi mai ɗigo (decimal hours): lokaci da aka rubuta a adadi mai ɗigo, kamar sa'o'i 7.75 don sa'o'i 7 da minti 45.
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye (amsoshi a ƙasa): (1) Ku canja ƙafa 5 zuwa inci. (2) Ku canja oza 48 zuwa fam. (3) Ɗakin ajiya ƙafa 9 ne da ƙafa 14. Nawa ne faɗin wurin? (4) Fenti yana rufe kusan ƙafa murabba'i 350 a kowane galan (a wannan gwangwani na ƙirƙira). Dole ku rufe ƙafa murabba'i 800. Galan nawa za ku saya? (5) Kuna aiki daga 6:45 na safe zuwa 3:15 na yamma da hutun abincin rana na minti 30 da ba a biya. Sa'o'i nawa, a adadi mai ɗigo? Amsoshi: (1) inci 60; (2) fam 3; (3) ƙafa murabba'i 126; (4) 800 / 350 = 2.29, don haka ku sayi galan 3; (5) sa'o'i 8.5 ban da 0.5 = sa'o'i 8.0.
Yanzu za ku iya canja ma'auni, nemo faɗin wuri, tara sama don cikakkun kaya, da ƙirga sa'o'in aikinku a adadi mai ɗigo.

check.q: Kuna buƙatar buhuna 4.2 na siminti. Buhuna nawa za ku saya?
check.why: Ba za ku iya sayen ɓangaren buhu ba, don haka ku tara sama zuwa 5.

check.q: Sa'o'i 7 da minti 45 sa'o'i nawa ne a adadi mai ɗigo?

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Duba takardar albashinku
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Duba sa'o'i, farashin sa'a, overtime, ragi da albashin da ake karɓa a hannu a takardar albashi.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku takardar albashi, za ku iya duba sa'o'i, farashin sa'a, overtime, ragi da albashin da ake karɓa a hannu layi-layi, kowane layi ya yi daidai har zuwa sisi, ko an rubuta kuskuren don a tambaya.
Takardar albashi (paystub) tana nuna yadda aka lissafa albashinku. Jimillar albashi (gross pay) ita ce abin da kuka samu kafin a cire komai. Ragi (deductions) su ne kuɗaɗen da aka cire, kamar haraji. Albashin hannu (net pay) shi ne abin da kuke karɓa a zahiri: jimillar albashi ban da ragi. YTD yana nufin year to date: jimillar zuwa yanzu a wannan shekarar.
Takardar albashi ta atisaye (ƙirƙirarriya): sa'o'i 45 a $18.00 a sa'a. A ƙarƙashin dokar tarayyar Amurka, ma'aikatan sa'a da dokar ta shafa suna samun overtime don sa'o'in da suka wuce 40 a mako na aiki, aƙalla ninki ɗaya da rabi. Don haka: 40 x $18.00 = $720.00 albashi na yau da kullum. Farashin overtime shi ne $18.00 x 1.5 = $27.00, kuma 5 x $27.00 = $135.00. Jimillar albashi = $855.00. Wasu jihohi suna da ƙarin dokokin overtime; ku duba ofishin ƙwadago na jiharku.
Ragi a wannan takarda: Social Security 6.2% na $855.00 = $53.01. Medicare 1.45% = $12.40. Harajin kuɗin shiga na tarayya $60.00 da harajin jiha $20.00 (waɗannan sun dogara da fom ɗinku na W-4 da jiharku; a nan ƙirƙirarru ne). Jimillar ragi = $145.41. Albashin hannu = $855.00 - $145.41 = $709.59.
Idan wani layi ba daidai ba ne, ku rubuta ranar biyan albashi, layin da abin da kuka yi tsammani, sannan ku fara tambayar sashen biyan albashi (payroll) ko shugabanku. Idan ba a gyara ba, kuna iya tuntuɓar ofishin ƙwadago na jiharku ko Wage and Hour Division na Ma'aikatar Ƙwadago ta Amurka. Ku ajiye takardun albashinku, kuma ku rufe lambar Social Security ɗinku kafin ku nuna wa kowa.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku duba sa'o'in da rubutunku na sa'o'in da kuka yi aiki.
- Albashi na yau da kullum: har zuwa sa'o'i 40 x farashinku.
- Overtime: sa'o'in da suka wuce 40 x (farashi x 1.5), idan dokar ta shafe ku.
- Jimillar albashi = albashi na yau da kullum + overtime + duk wani ƙarin albashi.
- Ku tara dukkan ragi.
- Albashin hannu = jimillar albashi - jimillar ragi. Ya yi daidai da takardar?
- Idan bai yi daidai ba, ku rubuta ku tambayi payroll.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Takardar albashi (paystub): takarda ko bayanin intanet da ke nuna yadda aka lissafa albashinku.
- Jimillar albashi (gross pay): abin da kuka samu kafin a cire komai.
- Albashin hannu (net pay): abin da kuke ɗauka gida bayan ragi; ana kuma kiransa take-home pay.
- Ragi (deduction): kuɗin da aka cire daga albashinku, kamar haraji ko inshora.
- Overtime: ƙarin albashi, aƙalla ninki 1.5 na farashinku, don sa'o'in da suka wuce 40 a mako na aiki a ƙarƙashin dokar tarayya.
- YTD (year to date): jimilla daga 1 ga Janairu har zuwa wannan albashin.
- W-4: fom ɗin da kuke ba mai ɗaukar ku aiki wanda ke ƙayyade yawan harajin kuɗin shiga na tarayya da za a cire.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Ma'aikatar Ƙwadago ta Amurka (DOL): biyan ƙarin lokacin aiki (overtime)
- IRS Topic 751: yawan cire kuɗin Social Security da Medicare
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye (amsoshi a ƙasa): Kun yi aiki sa'o'i 42 a $16.00 a sa'a. Ragi: Social Security 6.2%, Medicare 1.45%, harajin tarayya $45.00, harajin jiha $15.00 (ƙirƙirarru). Ku nemo (1) albashi na yau da kullum, (2) albashin overtime, (3) jimillar albashi, (4) jimillar ragi, (5) albashin hannu. Amsoshi: (1) $640.00; (2) 2 x $24.00 = $48.00; (3) $688.00; (4) $42.66 + $9.98 + $45.00 + $15.00 = $112.64; (5) $575.36. Sannan ku duba takardar albashinku ta gaske haka, da lambobin sirri a rufe.
Yanzu za ku iya duba kowane layi na takardar albashi, da sanin abin da za ku yi idan wani abu bai yi daidai ba.

check.q: Jimillar albashi $600.00 ce kuma jimillar ragi $95.00. Nawa ne albashin hannu?
Kuna samun $20.00 a sa'a kuma dokar overtime ta tarayya ta shafe ku. Nawa ne farashin overtime ɗinku?

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Yin kasafin kuɗi na wata daga albashinku
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Yin kasafin kuɗi na wata mai ajiya, wanda kashe kuɗi bai wuce kuɗin shiga ba.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan kuna da albashi na yau da kullum, za ku iya yin kasafin kuɗi na wata mai ajiya, wanda kashe kuɗi bai wuce kuɗin shiga ba, da kowane rukuni a rubuce kuma an duba jimloli.
Kasafin kuɗi (budget) tsari ne na kuɗinku. Ku fara da albashin hannu na wata. Watanni sun ɗan fi mako 4 tsawo, don haka kada ku ninka albashin mako da 4 kawai. Idan ana biyan ku kowane mako: albashin hannu na mako x 52 / 12. Idan ana biyan ku kowane mako biyu: albashin hannu x 26 / 12. Misali: $700 a mako x 52 = $36,400 a shekara, / 12 = $3,033.33 a wata.
Ku jera kashe kuɗinku: buƙatu tukuna (kuɗin haya, wuta da ruwa, abinci, sufuri, waya, kula da yara, mafi ƙarancin biyan bashi), sannan ajiya, sannan abubuwan sha'awa. Misali: haya $1,200, wuta da ruwa $150, waya $50, abinci $400, sufuri $200, bashi $150, ajiya $150. Jimilla $2,300 ce, kuma ta bar $733.33 don sauran buƙatu da abubuwan sha'awa.
Doka: jimillar kashe kuɗi (har da ajiya) dole ta yi daidai da kuɗin shiga ko ta gaza shi. Idan ta fi, ku cire wani abin sha'awa, ku rage wani lissafi, ko ku nemi ƙarin kuɗin shiga. Ku duba jimloli ta sake tara su a karo na biyu, ko da na'urar lissafi.
Ku bi diddigin sa har wata ɗaya. Ku rubuta abin da kuke kashewa a zahiri, sannan ku kwatanta da tsarinku ku gyara. Takardun "Your Money, Your Goals" na kyauta na Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (hukumar kare masu amfani da kuɗi ta Amurka) suna da takardun aiki da za ku iya bugawa.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku nemo albashin hannu na wata (na mako x 52 / 12, ko na mako biyu x 26 / 12).
- Ku jera buƙatu: haya, wuta da ruwa, abinci, sufuri, waya, kula da yara, mafi ƙarancin biyan bashi.
- Ku ƙara layin ajiya, ko da ƙarami ne.
- Ku ƙara abubuwan sha'awa a ƙarshe.
- Jimillar kashe kuɗi dole ta yi daidai da kuɗin shiga ko ta gaza shi.
- Ku bi diddigi har wata ɗaya ku gyara.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Kasafin kuɗi (budget): tsarin yadda za ku yi amfani da kuɗinku kowane wata.
- Kuɗin shiga (income): kuɗin da ke shigowa, kamar albashin hannunku.
- Kashe kuɗi (expense): kuɗin da ke fita, kamar haya ko kayan abinci.
- Kashe kuɗi na tsaye (fixed expense): kashe kuɗin da yake iri ɗaya kowane wata, kamar haya.
- Kashe kuɗi mai canjawa (variable expense): kashe kuɗin da ke canjawa kowane wata, kamar abinci ko man fetur.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- CFPB: Your Money, Your Goals (takardun kasafin kuɗi kyauta)
Gwada yanzu: Ku kammala aikinku na ƙarshe. Ku yi amfani da albashin hannu daga takardar albashi ta Darasi na 5 (ko taku) ku mayar da shi kuɗin shiga na wata. Ku rubuta kasafin kuɗi da buƙatu, layin ajiya da abubuwan sha'awa. Ku tara shi sau biyu. Idan kashe kuɗi ya fi kuɗin shiga, ku canja shi har ya dace. Ku sa duba takardar albashinku, kasafin kuɗinku da kwatancen farashin kowane ma'auni guda 3 a shafi ɗaya: "Takardar Lissafin Aiki da Kuɗi" taku.
Yanzu za ku iya mayar da albashi zuwa kuɗin shiga na wata, da yin kasafin kuɗi da ya daidaita kuma yana da ajiya.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce An duba takardar albashi Ba a duba wasu layuka ba, ko akwai kuskuren lissafi a jimillar albashi ko albashin hannu. An duba sa'o'i, farashi, overtime, ragi da albashin hannu; kowane layi ya yi daidai har zuwa sisi ko an rubuta kuskure. An kuma rubuta abin da za a faɗa wa payroll game da kowane kuskure da inda za a je na gaba. Kuɗin shiga na wata An ninka albashin mako da 4, ko an yi amfani da jimillar albashi a maimakon albashin hannu. An nemo albashin hannu na wata da x 52 / 12 ko x 26 / 12. An nuna lissafin kuma an duba shi ta wata hanya ta biyu. Kasafin kuɗi da ya daidaita Kashe kuɗi ya fi kuɗin shiga, ko babu layin ajiya. An jera buƙatu, ajiya da abubuwan sha'awa; kashe kuɗi bai wuce kuɗin shiga ba; an duba jimloli. Yana da tsarin bin diddigin ainihin kashe kuɗi da ranar sake dubawa. Farashin kowane ma'auni Kwatance ƙasa da 3, ko ma'aunai ba su yi daidai ba. Kwatance 3 da farashin kowane ma'auni daidai, kuma an yi alama a saye mafi riba. An rubuta lokacin da babban girma ba shi ne zaɓi mafi kyau ba da dalilin haka. Kashi cikin ɗari Amsoshin atisayen rangwame, haraji, tip ko ƙarin albashi sau da yawa ba daidai ba ne. Aƙalla 4 cikin 5 na atisayen kashi cikin ɗari daidai, har zuwa sisi. Zai iya bayyana wa wani dabarar gajeriyar hanya (10%, sannan a gina). Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku sake yin wannan sashe da matakan darasin ku sake dubawa.

check.q: Kuna ɗaukar $500 gida a mako. Nawa ne kuɗin shigarku na wata?
check.why: $500 x 52 / 12 = $2,166.67; ninka da 4 yana barin ƙarin kwanakin.

check.q: Kashe kuɗin da kuka tsara ya fi kuɗin shigarku da $50. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku bar tsarin ku yi fata
Ku cire layin ajiya ku manta da shi
Ku ci bashin payday loan kowane wata
Ku cire ko ku rage wasu kashe kuɗi har kashe kuɗin ya dace
check.why: Kasafin kuɗi yana aiki ne kawai idan kashe kuɗi ya yi daidai da kuɗin shiga ko ya gaza shi.
